provider: Scripted SDK responses; no provider calls
provenance: Project-authored synthetic scenarios. Held-out wording/parameters were frozen before execution, but authors know the implementation and supported recipes; not independently authored human data. No classifier retraining or prompt tuning on these held-out results.
limitations: Small project-authored synthetic suite, not independent human evaluation.
One model sample per request, with production bounded repairs; results can vary on repeated live runs.
Semantic predicates cover stated parameters/selection preservation, not arbitrary design intent, appearance, mechanical function or printability.
Concept approvals are explicit test-harness actions; the application requires user approval.
Offline passes establish wiring/scoring/geometry only, not language-model capability.
No prompt or classifier tuning is permitted against this frozen held-out score.
